thesis: Securitize is the leading regulated tokenization platform with ~$5B AUM, a strong regulatory moat, and ~$350M in post-SPAC cash. The company is positioned at the intersection of blockchain-based financial infrastructure and institutional adoption of tokenized real-world assets. However, the stock is loss-making, trades at an elevated ~30x annualized P/S, and faces significant regulatory and competitive uncertainty. The SPEC. BUY rating reflects the high-risk/high-reward nature of early-stage tokenization infrastructure plays.

drivers: SEC regulatory clarity accelerates RWA adoption; AUM grows to $10B+ by 2027
Revenue inflects to 40%+ growth; path to EBITDA breakeven by 2027
Multiple re-rates to 15x forward P/S as tokenization TAM expands

base_case.assumptions: AUM grows to $7B by 2027; revenue growth 20-25%; EBITDA breakeven by 2028; trades at 8-10x forward P/S

risks: Regulatory delays slow adoption; competition compresses fees
Cash burn accelerates; dilutive raise required
Trades at 4-5x forward P/S on reduced growth expectations

catalysts.event: Q3 2026 earnings — first full public quarter
SEC tokenized stock pilot program updates
Potential BlackRock BUIDL expansion and new institutional tokenized fund launches

key_risks: Regulatory uncertainty — SEC stance on tokenized securities could shift; five-year pilot is not permanent
Competition from traditional infrastructure providers (DTCC, Broadridge) and crypto-native platforms (Ondo, Centrifuge)
Customer concentration — BlackRock BUIDL represents significant portion of AUM
Cash burn — Adjusted EBITDA of $(5.5)M in Q2 2026; expansion could accelerate spending
Dilution risk — SPAC earnouts and lockup expirations could increase share count
